verdict.rationale: Bun's package manager is a CLI-only tool. The evidence shows every capability exposed as `bun` subcommands (install, add, remove, update, audit, publish, pm), with no separate graphical UI, so there is no UI feature set for an API to match. The probe found no OpenAPI spec, but that does not matter here because UI-versus-API parity does not apply to a CLI-only product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
